prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity full-page desktop website concept illustration for the existing Quran Universe reading and study app. This is a flat front-facing UI design, filling the image edge to edge, NOT a photo of a monitor or device. Tall portrait canvas around 1440 x 2200, showing the complete page from navigation to footer with readable, elegant typography. Restrained editorial design, Newsreader-like serif titles, clean sans-serif UI, beautifully typeset Arabic surah names. No people or religious figures, no photographic hero, no fake dashboards, no large abstract decorative artwork.
Keep the following exact composition and content across this series: slim top navigation with brand "Quran Universe" on left and "Quran", "Timeline", "Names of Allah" on right. Large two-column hero: left small eyebrow "READ · REFLECT · UNDERSTAND", headline "Every verse, made easy to understand", subtitle "Explore the Quran with translations, context, and reflections.", button "Start reading"; right an orderly 3-by-3 grid of popular surah cards labeled Al-Fatihah, Ayat al-Kursi, Al-Kahf, Ya-Sin, Ar-Rahman, Al-Waqi'ah, Al-Mulk, Maryam, Yusuf, with short Arabic surah names above English where possible.
Next a row of three equal exploration tiles "The Quran", "Timeline", "Names of Allah" with small restrained eight-point ornaments.
Next a section "A moment of reflection" with a wide elegant reading card, label "AL-FATIHAH · 1:1", exact translation "In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful." and three short subdued callouts "Understand", "Reflect", "Practice"; keep reading surfaces smooth and unobstructed. No invented Arabic verse text.
Next "Explore the surahs" with search field and six tidy rows in a two-column grid with number ornaments and English surah names: Al-Fatihah, Al-Baqarah, Ali 'Imran, An-Nisa, Al-Ma'idah, Al-An'am. Footer with Quran Universe and "Read with understanding".
Spacing generous but complete content visible; crisp small borders, softly rounded cards, very restrained shadows. Show material texture subtly at full-page scale only in outer page background, never impair reading. A small theme label in footer identifies this concept. Do not show hex codes or palette swatches inside the UI.

Theme: Parchment & Olive
Warm scholarly atmosphere. Page parchment #F3EFE5, cards ivory #FCFAF4, text dark olive #292D25, primary accent moss #536647. Muted antique gold only for tiny ornaments. Fine natural cotton-paper grain barely visible in margins, smooth ivory reading cards. No yellow sepia staining, no distressed antique effects.

Theme: Ivory & Deep Teal
